clips.title: The story
paras: In Westfall, The Defias Brotherhood still holds the farmlands in fear. Gryan Stoutmantle has found their stronghold beneath Moonbrook and calls for a final blow against their leader.

Gryan Stoutmantle and the People's Militia have fought the Defias Brotherhood across Westfall for months. Now the thieves' stronghold lies exposed beneath Moonbrook. Stoutmantle orders Edwin VanCleef assassinated, believing his death will break the rebellion once and for all.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: There is but one task left for you to complete. Edwin VanCleef must be assassinated. While it saddens me to condemn any man to a death sentence, it is for the greater good of the people of Westfall that VanCleef is laid to rest once and for all. Bring me the villain's head once the deed is done.

clips.title: Progress
paras: How goes the hunt for Edwin VanCleef?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Friend, your bravery is remarkable. The People's Militia thanks you for your service to the people of Westfall. With VanCleef dead, this marks the beginning of the end for the Defias Brotherhood. Hopefully some day soon peace will once again grace the plains of this fair land.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
